publicrecords/govcon-opportunity-feed: Use when you need new US federal contract opportunities (SAM.gov) and grants (Grants.gov) in one feed, optionally only items new since the last run.
publicrecords/grants-gov-scraper: Use when you need open US federal grant opportunities from Grants.gov with agency, deadline and eligibility.
publicrecords/usaspending-awards-scraper: Use when you need who won US federal contracts and grants and for how much (USAspending), by agency, recipient, NAICS or period.
publicrecords/uk-find-a-tender-scraper: Use when you need UK public-sector tenders from Find a Tender and Contracts Finder with buyer, value and deadline.
publicrecords/eu-ted-notices-scraper: Use when you need EU procurement notices from TED (Tenders Electronic Daily) with buyer, CPV code, value and deadline.
publicrecords/legistar-meetings-scraper: Use when you need city council or county board meetings, agenda items, votes and documents from a Legistar client (e.g. 'seattle', 'chicago').
